name: streambench
description: Browser-based IPTV, radio and stream tester.

scripts.build:client: npx --yes --package=typescript@7.0.2 tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && npx --yes --package=typescript@7.0.2 tsc -p tsconfig.client-orchestrators.json
scripts.build: npm run build:client && node scripts/vendor.mjs && node scripts/portable.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:raw && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run test:raw
